inputs.ad_text_01: Black-and-white observational documentary footage for a serious economics explainer. Neutral grayscale silver-gelatin photography, detailed faces and material textures, soft daylight, moderate contrast, clear readable composition. Original illustrative reconstruction. Natural restrained gestures, physically coherent objects and hands. Landscape 16:9. One continuous shot, gentle camera movement only. No subtitles, no readable lettering, no logos, no watermark, no graphic overlays. Medium wide shot in a busy contemporary East Asian company office. A manager welcomes two new employees and points to newly installed desks. Existing staff work in the background and a technician finishes placing an office chair. Ordinary corporate workplace, confident practical business activity.
